title: LLM-Augmented Flow for Project Conformation and Task Complexity Evaluation Based on the TLM Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.08931v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The software development process, from inception to a working product or solution, can be divided into two major phases: discovery (Discovery) and delivery (Delivery). The Discovery is further subdivided into High-Level Discovery (HLD) and Low-Level Discovery (LLD). During HLD, management identifies the business solution or product to be integrated into the company's infrastructure. LLD, in turn, produces requirement documentation artifacts, including the Product Requirements Document (PRD), Business Requirements Document (BRD), and Functional Specifications Document (FSD). Story Points (SP) are a widely used modern approach to measuring the effort required to accomplish predetermined tasks, and the artifacts listed above help derive SP more precisely. translated_title: 基于TLM框架的LLM增强流程：用于项目组建与任务复杂度评估
translated_abstract: 软件开发过程，从初始构想到可运行的产品或解决方案，可以划分为两个主要阶段：发现阶段和交付阶段。发现阶段进一步细分为高层发现和低层发现。在HLD阶段，管理层确定需要集成到公司基础设施中的业务解决方案或产品。LLD阶段则生成需求文档工件，包括产品需求文档（PRD）、业务需求文档（BRD）和功能规格文档（FSD）。故事点（SP）是一种被广泛使用的现代方法，用于衡量完成预定任务所需的工作量，而上述文档工件有助于更精确地推导SP。随着LLM技术的快速发展，一个主要问题随之而来：整个发现阶段（或其中大部分）是否能够借助LLM工具来完成。在本论文中……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于TLM框架的LLM增强流程，利用大语言模型辅助软件开发中发现阶段的需求文档生成与故事点估算，实现项目组建和任务复杂度评估的自动化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-augmented flow based on the TLM framework that leverages large language models to assist in the Discovery phase of software development, automating project conformation and task complexity evaluation through requirement document generation and Story Point estimation.
